supersedes: translator subsection in candidate_spec.json where this file is more specific
mechanism: Use the medium-dated NIFTY implied-vs-realized volatility state as an ex-ante context gate for an already-frozen BUY-only directional signal.

underlying.rv20: annualized standard deviation of the prior 20 completed close-to-close log returns; current session close is forbidden at the 15:00 state timestamp

features.atm_iv_per_expiry: mean of CE and PE IV from the contracts nearest |delta|=0.50
features.iv45: linear interpolation between eligible expiries bracketing 45 DTE; if not bracketed, nearest eligible expiry only when within 5 calendar days of 45
features.vrp_zscore: current vrp_proxy minus expanding prior-state mean, divided by expanding prior-state sample standard deviation; both moments shifted one state; minimum 60 prior observations

information_availability.state_timestamp: actual option snapshot timestamp near 15:00 IST
information_availability.join_rule: for each baseline entry use only the latest state_timestamp <= entry_timestamp
information_availability.morning_trade_rule: a trade before 15:00 IST cannot consume the same session's 15:00 state; it therefore uses the most recent prior session state when available
information_availability.missing_state_rule: trades without a non-null prior z-score are excluded from the apples-to-apples primary baseline comparison, not counted as gate rejects

primary_gate.rule: admit existing baseline trade iff latest available vrp_zscore <= 0

primary_null: Conditioning the frozen BUY-only baseline on vrp_zscore <= 0 does not improve net expectancy or downside-adjusted expectancy after controlling for coverage, costs, temporal stability, and regime dependence.
primary_endpoints: incremental mean net outcome versus the identical state-available baseline
